fullContentHtml:
Short Information : Shri Krishna Ayush University (SKAU) has released the notification for the Post Of Staff Nurse, Ayurvedic Pharmacist & Clerk. This recruitment has been issued for 60 posts. Online applying process for SKAU Kurukshetra Non Teaching Post Recruitment 2026 has started from 30 July 2026 & the candidates can apply till 21 August 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for SKAU Kurukshetra Non Teaching Post Recruitment 2026 which has given below. 

Shri Krishna Ayush University (SKAU)

SKAU Kurukshetra Non Teaching Post Recruitment 2026

SKAU Kurukshetra Non Teaching Post Advt No. : NT-01/2026 to 03/2026

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 30 July 2026
  • Last Date : 21 August 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 21 August 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General & Other State : Rs. 1500/-
  • Haryana Reserve Category : Rs. 750/-
  • PwBD Candidate : Rs. 00/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

[adinserter block=”3″]

SKAU Kurukshetra Non Teaching Post Notification 2026 : Age Limit

  • Age Limit As On 21 August 2026
  • Minimum Age : 18 Years
  • Maximum Age : 42 Years
  • Age Relaxation as per SKAU Recruitment Rules.
  • Use Tool –

SKAU Kurukshetra Non Teaching Post Online Form 2026 : Vacancy Details

Total Posts : 60 Posts

SKAU Kurukshetra Non Teaching Post Recruitment  2026 : Post Wise Vacancy Details

Post Name No. of Post 
Staff Nurse 25
Ayurvedic Pharmacist 06
Clerk 29

SKAU Kurukshetra Non Teaching Post Recruitment 2026 : Educational Qualification

Post Name Qualification
Staff Nurse
  • Candidates must have passed Matric (10th) from a recognized board, be registered with the Haryana Nurses Council, and have studied Hindi or Sanskrit at the Matric, 10+2, Undergraduate, or Postgraduate level.
Ayurvedic Pharmacist
  • Candidates must have passed Matric (10th) from a recognized board and possess either a UP-Vaidya qualification from a recognized university or 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry & Biology (PCB) along with a Diploma in Ayurvedic Pharmacy. Candidates must also have studied Hindi or Sanskrit at the Matric, 10+2, Undergraduate, or Postgraduate level. For more eligibility details, refer to the official notification.
Clerk
  • Candidates must have a Bachelor’s degree in any discipline from a recognized university, possess a typing speed of 30 WPM, and have studied Hindi or Sanskrit at the Matric, 10+2, Undergraduate, or Postgraduate level.

SKAU Kurukshetra Non Teaching Post Online Form 2026 : How To Apply

  • Candidates can apply through link https://skau.ac.in/ or provided below in link section or they can also apply through official site of the SKAU before Last Date.
  • You Can Check other Sarkari Result 2026 Notification Here – Check Now.
  • For all the interested and eligible candidates who want to apply for SKAU Kurukshetra Non Teaching Post recruitment can read all the information related to the recruitment is given below and the link to apply is given in the Important Link section below.
  • Note – छात्रो से ये अनुरोध किया जाता है की वो अपना फॉर्म भरने से पहले Official Notification (Last Date, Age Limit, Qualification) को ध्यान से जरूर पढे उसके बाद ही अपना फॉर्म भरे।

  • Written Exam 
  • Medical Verification
  • FInal Merit List
